response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished senior engineer with 16+ years of broad software development experience, he lacks critical requirements for this embedded firmware security role. Most significantly, he does not have native-level Japanese proficiency (an explicit requirement), no embedded systems or firmware development background, and no demonstrated expertise in security technologies (encryption, authentication protocols, attack detection). His entire career has focused on web, mobile, and application-layer development rather than the systems-level embedded work required for LAN-switch security features.
strengths: Proven senior-level engineering capability with 16+ years of professional experience and demonstrated technical leadership across multiple roles
Strong Linux systems foundation from infrastructure roles at Dunnhumby and Altom, including experience with low-latency systems and backend services
Broad programming language proficiency and ability to quickly learn new technical domains, as evidenced by work across web, mobile, desktop, and infrastructure
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency; resume lists only English (fluent), Romanian (fluent), and German (basic)—this is an explicit job requirement
Entire career focused on web, mobile, and application-layer development with zero embedded firmware, network infrastructure, or embedded security experience
No demonstrated expertise in required security technologies (encryption key exchange, 802.1X authentication, tamper detection) or network protocols (Layer 2/3 switching, NETCONF, SNMP, MACsec)

key_factors.factor: C Systems Programming & Linux Kernel Knowledge
